title: Lysis Pre-Fill for Salmonella and Listeria
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Select Lysis Type (Salmonella – 90 µL fill, or Listeria – 70 µL fill), specify number of plates to fill (1–9), choose pipette type (P300 single‑channel or P300 multi‑channel), and set tip‑pickup column to row A to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Load labware onto deck
steps.instruction: Place Fisherbrand 20‑200 µL tip rack in Slot 1, Nest 195 mL reservoir (or equivalent) in Slot 2, and load Simport Scientific 500 µL tubes in their custom holder sequentially into Slots 3 through 11.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map, matching the labware positions defined above.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, calibrate the tip rack, reservoir, tube holder, and the selected P300 pipette (single‑ or multi‑channel) following the app’s calibration routine; use calibration tips as described in the support articles.

steps.title: Generate and download protocol
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 protocol editor, input the chosen parameters, then download the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the OT‑2 Run App (version 3.15.0 or later) and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Execute protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT‑2 App to start the lysis pre‑fill operation.
